sequential_dependency.intermediate: The fully expanded binary foreground occupancy and its four-neighbor connected components, including cross-tile joins determined by motif boundary ports.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the monochrome layout and multicolor motif, then expand every occupied layout cell by the complete motif.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the complete maximum-area component class and recolor its occupied cells to 9.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: A larger pre-expansion layout cluster can split into smaller expanded components when opposing motif boundary ports do not meet. The counterfactual counts layout clusters before the required expansion.
